title: Open Robotics RViz RGB8PCTransformer PointField Out-Of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-134048)
description: A denial-of-service vulnerability exists in Open Robotics RViz's RGB8PCTransformer component due to an out-of-bounds read in PointField handling. This flaw allows network-adjacent attackers to cause a crash without authentication by exploiting improper validation of PointCloud2 message data.
